text: Wide 16:9 cinematic sci-fi concept art, desert at twilight. Foreground left: a lone figure in a long flowing red cloak stands on a rippled sand dune, back to viewer, beside one woolly llama/alpaca to their left, both silhouetted and facing a distant futuristic city. Sky: deep navy starry upper left, gradient to peach/orange sunset lower right; huge thin white crescent moon upper left with faint glow. Center background: glowing neon metropolis, central ultra-tall spire with translucent cyan halo ring floating above; left cyan skyscraper with vertical neon text "OASIS"; right magenta-lit tower; curved terraced bases and low city lights. Multiple cyan/magenta searchlight beams sweep upward. Right foreground: curved elevated road with glowing yellow edges and a blue train car, turquoise oasis pool, large saguaro cactus with magenta rim light and a smaller cactus. Warm orange dunes with fine wind ripples. Digital illustration, futuristic synthwave lighting, high detail, dramatic scale, sharp focus, centered composition.
